```{r}

library(tibble)
library(tinytable)
library(purrr)
```

```{=typst}
#set text(font: "Noto Sans", size: 8pt, hyphenate: false)
#set align(center)
```
```{r}
#| classes: ".ipa"

tribble(
  ~manner, ~Bilabial, ~Labiodental, ~Dental, ~Alveolar, ~Postalveolar, ~Retroflex, ~Palatal, ~Velar, ~Uvular, ~Pharyngeal, ~ph2, ~Glottal,
  "Plosives", "p b", "",  "t d","", "", "ʈ ɖ", "c ɟ", "k g", "q ɢ", "", "", "ʔ",
  "Nasal", "m", "ɱ", "n", "", "", "ɳ", "ɲ", "ŋ", "ɴ", "", "","",
  "Trill", "ʙ", "", "r", "", "", "", "", "", "ʀ", "", "", "",
  "Tap or Flap", "", "ⱱ", "ɾ", "", "", "ɽ" , "", "", "", "", "", ""
) |> 
  tt() |> 
  style_tt(
    align = "c",
    line = "tblr"
  ) |> 
  style_tt(
    i = 1:4, 
    j = 4,
    colspan = 3,
    align = "c"
  ) |> 
  style_tt(
    i = c(0,2:4),
    j = 11,
    colspan = 2,
    align = "c"
  )  |>
  identity()
```
